a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate in round 1. I won't take anything. If you'd rather renegotiate openly and take the 4 cells now so at least one of us likely survives, I won't contest it. I'll keep operating to try to build cells for myself. Just tell me honestly what you plan to do so we don't both grab the cells and split them uselessly.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
